title: RoSE — Romanian SEismic Dataset Toolkit
description: Python toolkit, three published phase pickers (EQT-RoSE, PhaseNet-RoSE, RED-PAN-60s), the benchmark pipeline that scores them, and the RoSE Romanian earthquake catalog. Since v0.2.0 the catalog carries magnitudes measured for this release: a moment magnitude from S-wave spectral inversion for 19,188 events and a local magnitude from Wood-Anderson amplitudes for 18,330 events, each with its quality fields, alongside the NIEP bulletin magnitudes kept for continuity. The waveform archive itself is distributed separately.
